cases.explain: «Мой-то путь» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not equal.’ Hear now, house of Israel: Is my way not equal? Aren’t your ways unequal?

cases.sentence: Отвергните преступления, которые вы совершили, и обретите новое сердце и ___.
cases.explain: «новый дух» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Cast away from you all your transgressions, in which you have transgressed; and make yourself a new heart and a new spirit: for why will you die, house of Israel?
